lines.en: I walk the originium forest.
I know the oriforest well.
I move lightly, tail up.
My claws are sheathed.
Fine lines run along my shell.
I circled behind you and sniffed.
I sniff the ground as I walk.
Strangers coming near do not frighten me.
I walk at your back quarter.
My steps are soft.
I walk toward the brighter spot.
Tree shadows slide over me.
I lie down a moment.
I scratch my ear with a hind leg.
I listen to the forest.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴打了个大哈欠
lines.en: I open wide for a big yawn.
My tail sweeps the leaves.
I am in no hurry.
I stare at one spot.
A faint light clings to me.
I rolled over on the ground.
I wait for you to offer something.
The forest is safe.
I shake the fur on my back.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳被摸过很多次
lines.en: Many hands have touched my shell.
I bury my nose in my forepaws.
You are staring at me.
I do not hide at all.

lines.zh: 你的手上有食物的味道
lines.en: Your hands smell of food.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在光下是亮的
lines.en: My eyes shine in the light.
I come one step nearer.
It is better if you crouch.
I have never bitten anyone.
It is iron I smell on your hands.
I might be able to help.
I have studied you a while.

lines.zh: 你抬手的动作吓到我了
lines.en: Your raised hand startled me.
I tilt my head, waiting for you to speak.
Sit down and I will come.
My ear tilts toward you.
I can smell that you are tense.
Is that iron for me?
I trust you a little now.
Your weapon does not frighten me.
I am not afraid when you smile.
We are acquainted now.
I tucked my tail under.
My shell cracked.
I retreat behind you.
My tail is tucked.
It hurt enough to make me yelp.
Do you still want my trust?

lines.zh: 源石在我血里烧，别添乱。
lines.en: Originium burns in my blood — don't add to it.
The shell's cracked; I can hold out a while longer.
I want that thing.
I can reach it even held high.
That will make me stronger.
Let me sniff this iron first.
Do you have more iron?
Eat it and I will obey better.
Put it down in front of me.
Do not take it back.
I do not eat ordinary meat.
This is more useful than leaves.
I have taken a piece.
You have more iron, right?
I am willing to follow you.
Give me one more and I am yours.
I have sheathed my claws.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳磕到你的膝盖。
lines.en: My shell knocks against your knee.
That rusty smell is getting closer.
My shell is hard; your bones are not.
You were not hurt in that, were you?
I only bumped into you.
My tail caught you.
Neither of us is hurt.
Do not step on my tail.
I slip around past you.
I already have a master.
Ask my master about that.
I only want my head patted.
You ask too suddenly.
There are few of my kind here.
I prefer lying quietly.
Not interested in that topic.
Just pat me.
I roll over to decline.
Let us do something else.
I picked it up in my mouth.
This lump of iron is hard.
I trot over, tail wagging.
It fell by the roots.
I set it by your feet.
It has my tooth marks now.
I can fetch it again.
Throw it farther; I will fetch.
This has always been my job.
Do not snatch this from me.
Something smells wrong over there.
My ears are up.
I set myself across your path.
Someone seems to be coming.
I know this smell.
I lowered my head.
Let me go and look first.
Stay behind me.
My claws are out.
I will stay by your side.
I track low to the ground.
It is hiding behind that tree.
I will go around behind it.
My tail has gone still.
We close in from both sides.
I have made my steps quieter.
It is still in this wood.
Fire licks across my shell, hot.
I wait for a signal from you.
I spring at it.
My claws are held back.
My claws hooked in.
It fell back; I chase.
I bit down and did not let go.
I am not hurt in the least.
I knocked it aside.
You go in and finish it.
My shell took a blow.
I can keep fighting a while.
The oriforest has me now.
I smelled someone passing.
I poke my head out to look at you.

lines.zh: 四只一起出现，我是第一只
lines.en: Four of us come; I am the first.
My shell has new lines.
I step through a layer of leaves.
I count no one a stranger.
I approach, tail wagging.
Offer me a piece of iron.
I lower my tail and step aside.
I fell into the bushes.
Water makes me swim crooked.
The blast rolled me far away.
An arrow lodged in my shell's seam.
The spell makes my fur stand.
Without iron I grow weak.
Lightning leaves me numb.
There is no forest here.
